findings.finding: Immutable claim/context does not establish that the latest before witness still mismatches. A genuine historical contradicted state carried through recovery by keep_all can be accepted and cause supported state to remain withheld.
findings.bounded_condition: Negative fact must bind to the witness at last actual validation, or arrive through a verified uninterrupted chain of safe carries. Freshly validate before enabling carry on arbitrary imported state.

findings.finding: Same claim_id with revised expected signature can be incorrectly carried. Prototype explicitly requires immutable claim/context but has no executable binding.
findings.bounded_condition: Bind the complete claim, provenance, parser/validator/configuration and negative witness, not only IDs and current provenance.

findings.finding: Adapter repeats snapshot limitation and module/definition/signature checks for both indexes. Production structural validation already consumes shared indexes and performs a cheap lookup/comparison. Fewer validator calls are not a demonstrated reduction in substantive work.
findings.bounded_condition: Count guard/witness creation, index work and end-to-end maintenance. An exact unchanged regular module blob witness tied to the actual negative check is a simpler narrower candidate.

sound_scope: For truthful signature mismatch, fixed exact claim/context, authentic consistent indexes, and uninterrupted safe state lineage, unique unambiguous unchanged signature preserves predicate_mismatch. Source signature recovery is selected and validated; absence/ambiguity/limitations remain retried.
availability_note: Counterexamples incorrectly prolong unavailability; they do not create false availability. Last negative verdict and check provenance still matter.
recommendation: Keep this version as a proof-oriented research prototype. Prefer the smallest witness-bound candidate for further measurement; no production change or speedup claim follows from this review.
